name: get_inspiration
description: Search 21st for metadata-only components, themes, and templates, then rerank them against a project's Design Context. Returns confidence and concrete rationales without retrieving paid component code. Use this before generation or implementation when project stack, primitives, tokens, constraints, or prior decisions should influence the result.

context.description: Optional `.21st/design.json` object. Send only when the user explicitly invokes project-aware search.

diversity.description: Prefer coverage across types and authors instead of near-duplicates (default true).

query.description: The UI or product need to find inspiration for.
